Eval Plan Step 6 (B1) COMPLETE: bench_speed.py --fmts all ran 8-cell grid (batch 1/8/32/128 x input 128/512, 128 out tokens) for 6 formats on L4, saved to results/bench/<fmt>.json. Decode TPOT at bs=1: bf16 25.55 ms, w8a16_pt/pc 14.66 (1.74x faster), w8a8_pc/pt_dyn 16.4, w8a8_pt_static 16.0 (1.6x). Peak throughput bs=128 in=128 (out tok/s): bf16 2504, w8a16_pt 2891, w8a16_pc 2860, w8a8_pc 3374, w8a8_pt_dyn 3397, w8a8_pt_static 3427 (+37%); bs=128 in=512: bf16 1223, w8a16 1220-1222 (parity), w8a8 1600-1615 (+32%). Prefill bs=128 in=512: bf16 7.72s, w8a16 8.74s (slower, dequant overhead), w8a8 5.78s (1.34x faster). Crossover: W8A16 (Marlin) best for decode at bs<=32, W8A8 (native FP8 tensor cores) best at large batch/prefill. per-tensor vs per-channel and static vs dynamic differ <2% in speed. Caveats: logged weights=None and empty kernel_log because EngineCore subprocess logs are not captured by python logger -> weight GiB must come from results/size_*.json; mem_used_after (~19.3-19.6 GiB) is ~constant because GPU_MEM_UTIL=0.85 pre-allocates, so it is not a memory-saving metric; KV-cache capacity not captured yet
